verses.original: לִבְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְלִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד הָיָ֞ה מְאֹ֑ד עָצ֣וּם וּמִקְנֶ֣ה׀ רַ֗ב וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת־ אֶ֤רֶץ יַעְזֵר֙ וְאֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַמָּק֖וֹם מְק֥וֹם מִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê rə·’ū·ḇên wə·liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ hā·yāh mə·’ōḏ ‘ā·ṣūm ū·miq·neh raḇ way·yir·’ū ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ ya‘·zêr wə·’eṯ- ’e·reṣ gil·‘āḏ wə·hin·nêh ham·mā·qō·wm mə·qō·wm miq·neh
verses.literal: Now the Reubenites . . . and Gadites . . . who had very large herds and flocks - surveyed - the lands of Jazer - - and Gilead and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock

verses.original: בְנֵֽי־ גָ֖ד וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·yō·mə·rū ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·’el- nə·śî·’ê hā·‘ê·ḏāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: So the Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . came - to Moses . . . Eleazar the priest . . . and the leaders of the congregation and said

verses.original: עֲטָר֤וֹת וְדִיבֹן֙ וְיַעְזֵ֣ר וְנִמְרָ֔ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה וּשְׂבָ֥ם וּנְב֖וֹ וּבְעֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṭā·rō·wṯ wə·ḏî·ḇōn wə·ya‘·zêr wə·nim·rāh wə·ḥeš·bō·wn wə·’el·‘ā·lêh ū·śə·ḇām ū·nə·ḇōw ū·ḇə·‘ōn
verses.literal: Ataroth Dibon Jazer Nimrah Heshbon Elealeh Sebam Nebo and Beon

verses.original: הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ הִכָּ֤ה לִפְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֥רֶץ מִקְנֶ֖ה הִ֑וא וְלַֽעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מִקְנֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh hik·kāh lip̄·nê ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’e·reṣ miq·neh hî wə·la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā miq·neh
verses.literal: - which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel are suitable for livestock . . . and your servants have livestock

verses.original: אִם־ מָצָ֤אנוּ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ הַזֹּ֛את הָאָ֧רֶץ יֻתַּ֞ן אֶת־ לַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה אַל־ תַּעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- mā·ṣā·nū ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā way·yō·mə·rū haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ yut·tan ’eṯ- la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh ’al- ta·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: If we have found favor in your sight they said let this land be given - to your servants as a possession Do not make us cross - the Jordan

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד וְלִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן הַאַֽחֵיכֶ֗ם יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם תֵּ֥שְׁבוּ פֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ wə·liḇ·nê rə·’ū·ḇên ha·’a·ḥê·ḵem yā·ḇō·’ū lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·’at·tem tê·šə·ḇū p̄ōh
verses.literal: But Moses asked the Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here

verses.original: וְלָ֣מָּה תְנוּאוּן אֶת־ לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵֽעֲבֹר֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָֽה׃ נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·lām·māh ṯə·nū·ʾūn ’eṯ- lêḇ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ă·ḇōr ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh nā·ṯan lā·hem
verses.literal: Why are you discouraging - - the Israelites . . . from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם עָשׂ֖וּ בְּשָׁלְחִ֥י אֹתָ֛ם מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem ‘ā·śū bə·šā·lə·ḥî ’ō·ṯām miq·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: This is what your fathers did when I sent - them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect - the land

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֞וּ עַד־ נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֗וֹל וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּנִ֕יאוּ אֶת־ לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְבִלְתִּי־ בֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָֽה׃ נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū ‘aḏ- na·ḥal ’eš·kō·wl way·yir·’ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·nî·’ū ’eṯ- lêḇ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇil·tî- ḇō ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh nā·ṯan lā·hem
verses.literal: For when [your fathers] went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw - the land they discouraged - - the Israelites . . . from entering . . . the land that the LORD had given them

verses.original: אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּֽחַר־ הַה֑וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ Yah·weh way·yi·ḥar- ha·hū bay·yō·wm way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lê·mōr
verses.literal: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day and He swore an oath saying

verses.original: כִּ֥י לֹא־ אַחֲרָֽי׃ מִלְא֖וּ אִם־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים עֶשְׂרִ֤ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה אֵ֚ת הָעֹלִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם יִרְא֨וּ הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ’a·ḥă·rāy mil·’ū ’im- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh ’êṯ hā·‘ō·lîm mim·miṣ·ra·yim yir·’ū hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly not one of the men twenty years of age . . . or older - who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham Isaac and Jacob

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן כִּ֥י אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ מִלְא֖וּ
verses.transliteration: bil·tî kā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh haq·qə·niz·zî wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn kî ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh mil·’ū
verses.literal: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly

verses.original: אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ וַיִּֽחַר־ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְנִעֵם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־ כָּל־ הַדּ֔וֹר הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע יְהוָֽה׃ בְּעֵינֵ֥י תֹּם֙
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ Yah·weh way·yi·ḥar- bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·ni·‘êm bam·miḏ·bār ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ‘aḏ- kāl- had·dō·wr hā·‘ō·śeh hā·ra‘ Yah·weh bə·‘ê·nê tōm
verses.literal: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years until the whole generation who had done evil in [His] sight was gone

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם ע֗וֹד לִסְפּ֣וֹת עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh tar·būṯ ’ă·nā·šîm ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm qam·tem ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem ‘ō·wḏ lis·pō·wṯ ‘al ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh ’el- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now behold you, a brood of sinners have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke . . . the burning anger of the LORD against Israel

verses.original: כִּ֤י תְשׁוּבֻן֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו וְיָסַ֣ף ע֔וֹד לְהַנִּיח֖וֹ הַזֶּֽה׃ס הָעָ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְשִֽׁחַתֶּ֖ם לְכָל־
verses.transliteration: kî ṯə·šū·ḇun mê·’a·ḥă·rāw wə·yā·sap̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·han·nî·ḥōw haz·zeh hā·‘ām bam·miḏ·bār wə·ši·ḥat·tem lə·ḵāl
verses.literal: For if you turn away from following Him He will once again . . . leave this people in the wilderness and you will be the cause of their destruction . . .

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ וַ֣יֹּאמְר֔וּ נִבְנֶ֥ה גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן פֹּ֑ה לְמִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְעָרִ֖ים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū ’ê·lāw way·yō·mə·rū niḇ·neh giḏ·rōṯ ṣōn pōh lə·miq·nê·nū wə·‘ā·rîm lə·ṭap·pê·nū
verses.literal: Then [the Gadites and Reubenites] approached [Moses] and said We want to build sheepfolds . . . here for our livestock and cities for our little ones

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם־ הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖ם אֶל־ מְקוֹמָ֑ם טַפֵּ֙נוּ֙ וְיָשַׁ֤ב הַמִּבְצָ֔ר בְּעָרֵ֣י מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·naḥ·nū nê·ḥā·lêṣ ḥu·šîm lip̄·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ ’ă·šer ’im- hă·ḇî·’ō·num ’el- mə·qō·w·mām ṭap·pê·nū wə·yā·šaḇ ham·miḇ·ṣār bə·‘ā·rê mip·pə·nê yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites . . . until - - we have brought them into their place Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land

verses.original: לֹ֥א נָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־ בָּתֵּ֑ינוּ עַ֗ד אִ֖ישׁ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִתְנַחֵל֙ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō nā·šūḇ ’el- bāt·tê·nū ‘aḏ ’îš bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hiṯ·na·ḥêl na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite . . . has taken possession of his inheritance

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָהָ֑לְאָה כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ מִזְרָֽחָה׃פ מֵעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן
verses.transliteration: kî lō nin·ḥal ’it·tām mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên wā·hā·lə·’āh kî ḇā·’āh na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū ’ê·lê·nū miz·rā·ḥāh mê·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond because . . . our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אִֽם־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּן אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה אִם־ תֵּחָֽלְצ֛וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’im- ta·‘ă·śūn ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’im- tê·ḥā·lə·ṣū lip̄·nê Yah·weh lam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Moses replied - If you will do - - this if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle

verses.original: כָּל־ חָל֛וּץ אֶת־ וְעָבַ֨ר לָכֶ֧ם הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛וֹ אֶת־ אֹיְבָ֖יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ḥā·lūṣ ’eṯ- wə·‘ā·ḇar lā·ḵem hay·yar·dên lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘aḏ hō·w·rî·šōw ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇāw mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: and if every one of your armed men - crosses the Jordan before the LORD until He has driven - His enemies out before Him

verses.original: הָאָ֜רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִהְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ים מֵיְהוָ֖ה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַזֹּ֥את הָאָ֨רֶץ וְ֠הָיְתָה לָכֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ wə·niḵ·bə·šāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·’a·ḥar tā·šu·ḇū wih·yî·ṯem nə·qî·yîm Yah·weh ū·mî·yiś·rā·’êl haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lā·ḵem la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: then when the land is subdued before the LORD - you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וּדְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯa·‘ă·śūn kên hin·nêh ḥă·ṭā·ṯem Yah·weh ū·ḏə·‘ū ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem ’ă·šer tim·ṣā ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: But if you do not do this you will certainly sin against the LORD and be assured that your sin - will find you out -

verses.original: בְּנֽוּ־ עָרִים֙ לָכֶ֤ם לְטַפְּכֶ֔ם וּגְדֵרֹ֖ת לְצֹנַאֲכֶ֑ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ וְהַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: bə·nū- ‘ā·rîm lā·ḵem lə·ṭap·pə·ḵem ū·ḡə·ḏê·rōṯ lə·ṣō·na·’ă·ḵem ta·‘ă·śū wə·hay·yō·ṣê mip·pî·ḵem
verses.literal: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks but do what you have promised . . .

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ גָד֙ וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ya·‘ă·śū ka·’ă·šer ’ă·ḏō·nî mə·ṣaw·weh
verses.literal: The Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . said to Moses . . . Your servants will do just as our lord commands

verses.original: טַפֵּ֣נוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ מִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְכָל־ בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑נוּ יִֽהְיוּ־ שָׁ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֥י הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ṭap·pê·nū nā·šê·nū miq·nê·nū wə·ḵāl bə·hem·tê·nū yih·yū- šām bə·‘ā·rê hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Our children our wives our livestock and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead

verses.original: וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א כָּל־ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י דֹּבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ḥă·lūṣ ṣā·ḇā kāl- ya·‘aḇ·rū lam·mil·ḥā·māh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ’ă·ḏō·nî dō·ḇêr
verses.literal: But your servants are equipped for war and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD just as our lord says

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיְצַ֤ו לָהֶם֙ אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן וְאֶת־ אֲב֥וֹת רָאשֵׁ֛י הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ṣaw lā·hem ’êṯ ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·’êṯ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·wṯ rā·šê ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Moses gave orders about them - to Eleazar the priest - to Joshua son of Nun - and to the family leaders of the tribes vvv of Israel

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִם־ בְנֵי־ גָ֣ד וּבְנֵי־ רְאוּבֵ֣ן׀ יַעַבְר֣וּ הַיַּרְדֵּ֞ן אִ֠תְּכֶם אֶֽת־ כָּל־ חָל֤וּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’im- ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên ya·‘aḇ·rū hay·yar·dên ’it·tə·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- ḥā·lūṣ lam·mil·ḥā·māh lip̄·nê Yah·weh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·niḵ·bə·šāh lip̄·nê·ḵem ū·nə·ṯat·tem lā·hem ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ hag·gil·‘āḏ la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh
verses.literal: And Moses said to them If the Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . cross the Jordan with you - with every man armed for battle before the LORD and the land is subdued before you then you are to give them - the land of Gilead as a possession

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֧א חֲלוּצִ֖ים יַֽעַבְר֛וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְנֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְתֹכְכֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ḥă·lū·ṣîm ya·‘aḇ·rū ’it·tə·ḵem wə·nō·ḥă·zū ḇə·ṯō·ḵə·ḵɛm bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: But if they do not arm themselves [and] go across with you then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan

verses.original: בְנֵי־ גָ֛ד וּבְנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵת֩ וַיַּֽעֲנ֧וּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה דִּבֶּ֧ר אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên lê·mōr ’êṯ way·ya·‘ă·nū ’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā kên na·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: The Gadites . . . and Reubenites . . . . . . - replied As the LORD has spoken to your servants so we will do

verses.original: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאִתָּ֙נוּ֙ נַחֲלָתֵ֔נוּ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: naḥ·nū na·‘ă·ḇōr ’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an ḥă·lū·ṣîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·’it·tā·nū na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên
verses.literal: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD that we may have our inheritance . . . on this side of the Jordan

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֡ה וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֣ם׀ לִבְנֵי־ גָד֩ וְלִבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְלַחֲצִ֣י׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט׀ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת־ מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֶת־ מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן הָאָ֗רֶץ לְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּגְבֻלֹ֔ת סָבִֽיב׃ עָרֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yit·tên lā·hem liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ wə·liḇ·nê rə·’ū·ḇên wə·la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh ḇen- yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- mam·le·ḵeṯ sî·ḥōn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’eṯ- mam·le·ḵeṯ ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān hā·’ā·reṣ lə·‘ā·re·hā biḡ·ḇu·lōṯ sā·ḇîḇ ‘ā·rê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So Moses gave to the Gadites . . . to the Reubenites . . . and to the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh son of Joseph - the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites - and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them . . .

verses.original: בְנֵי־ גָ֔ד אֶת־ וַיִּבְנ֣וּ דִּיבֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ עֲטָרֹ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת עֲרֹעֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ’eṯ- way·yiḇ·nū dî·ḇōn wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ṭā·rōṯ wə·’êṯ ‘ă·rō·‘êr
verses.literal: And the Gadites . . . - built up Dibon - Ataroth - Aroer

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַטְרֹ֥ת שׁוֹפָ֛ן וְאֶת־ יַעְזֵ֖ר וְיָגְבֳּהָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘aṭ·rōṯ šō·w·p̄ān wə·’eṯ- ya‘·zêr wə·yā·ḡə·bo·hāh
verses.literal: - vvv Atroth-shophan - Jazer Jogbehah

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית נִמְרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הָרָ֑ן מִבְצָ֖ר עָרֵ֥י וְגִדְרֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bêṯ nim·rāh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ hā·rān miḇ·ṣār ‘ā·rê wə·ḡiḏ·rōṯ ṣōn
verses.literal: - vvv Beth-nimrah - vvv and Beth-haran as fortified cities and they built folds for their flocks

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י רְאוּבֵן֙ בָּנ֔וּ אֶת־ חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ אֶלְעָלֵ֑א וְאֵ֖ת קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên bā·nū ’eṯ- ḥeš·bō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’el·‘ā·lê wə·’êṯ qir·yā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: The Reubenites . . . built up - Heshbon - Elealeh - Kiriathaim

verses.original: וְאֶת־ נְב֞וֹ וְאֶת־ בַּ֧עַל מְע֛וֹן שֵׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שִׂבְמָ֑ה וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ בְשֵׁמֹ֔ת אֶת־ שְׁמ֥וֹת הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- nə·ḇōw wə·’eṯ- ba·‘al mə·‘ō·wn šêm wə·’eṯ- mū·sab·bōṯ śiḇ·māh way·yiq·rə·’ū ḇə·šê·mōṯ ’eṯ- šə·mō·wṯ he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer bā·nū
verses.literal: - as well as Nebo - vvv and Baal-meon (whose names - were changed and Sibmah And they renamed . . . - - the cities - they rebuilt

verses.original: בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ גִּלְעָ֖דָה וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֑הָ וַיּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת־ הָאֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh way·yê·lə·ḵū gil·‘ā·ḏāh way·yil·kə·ḏu·hā way·yō·w·reš ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer- bāh
verses.literal: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead captured it and drove out - the Amorites who were there

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמָכִ֖יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yit·tên hag·gil·‘āḏ lə·mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh way·yê·šeḇ bāh
verses.literal: So Moses - gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh and they settled there

verses.original: וְיָאִ֤יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֖ד אֶת־ חַוֺּתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·’îr ben- mə·naš·šeh hā·laḵ way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- ḥaw·wō·ṯê·hem way·yiq·rā ’eṯ·hen ḥaw·wōṯ yā·’îr
verses.literal: Jair a descendant of Manasseh went and captured - their villages and called - them Havvoth-jair

verses.original: וְנֹ֣בַח הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד אֶת־ קְנָ֖ת וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֧א לָ֦ה נֹ֖בַח בִּשְׁמֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·ḇaḥ hā·laḵ way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- qə·nāṯ wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯe·hā way·yiq·rā lāh nō·ḇaḥ biš·mōw
verses.literal: And Nobah went and captured - Kenath - and its villages and called it Nobah after his own name
